adjudicated_statement: Work over C with Q-coefficients, at (g,n)=(6,6). Let (C_0,gamma_0) be a geometric type-(i) fibre of H^bal in the sense of FND-0153, for instance any simply-branched balanced fibre (existence: FND-0172). Let B be a reduced separated finite-type C-scheme. The constant (CE)+(N)+(BAL) family over B with fibre (C_0,gamma_0) is an allowed ATT-0112 clause-(E) base, because its classifying image is a single type-(i) point. For this family, A=P_B(pi_*L) is isomorphic to B times |L_0| isomorphic to B times P^2, the reduced-support open U_0 of |L_0| is a nonempty smooth connected affine surface (the complement of the discriminant curve of the spanned g^2_6), U is isomorphic to B times U_0, and Z=Ord(U) isomorphic to B times Z_0 is the finite etale right S_6-torsor of orderings. Poincare duality on the smooth connected surface U_0, equivalently compact-support localization of U_0 subset P^2 against the discriminant curve Delta_0 of dimension 1, yields H_c^4(U_0;Q) isomorphic to Q(-2), pure of type (2,2). Compact-support Kunneth of mixed Hodge structures for products of separated finite-type C-schemes (the compact-support form of Deligne, Theorie de Hodge III, Proposition 8.2.10) therefore realises H_c^m(B;Q)(-2) as a direct mixed-Hodge-structure summand of H_c^{m+4}(U;Q) for every integer m, and, Q(-2) being pure of weight 4 with Gr^W exact, realises Gr^W_m H_c^m(B;Q)(-2) as a direct summand of Gr^W_{m+4} H_c^{m+4}(U;Q). Finite-etale transfer over Q identifies Gr^W_{m+4} H_c^{m+4}(U;Q) with the S_6-invariants inside Gr^W_{m+4} H_c^{m+4}(Z;Q). Consequently any theorem asserting that Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(-8) for every allowed clause-(E) base forces Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(B;Q) to be a finite direct sum of Q(-6) for every reduced separated finite-type C-scheme B. This last assertion is false: if C is the affine Kummer curve of FND-0170 (the smooth projective model of y^3=x(x-1) minus the three ramification points of x), then for B=C^8 compact-support Kunneth supplies a nonzero Hodge component of type (8,4) in Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(B;Q), namely Q(-1)^{tensor 4} tensor (Gr^W_1 H_c^1(C;Q))^{tensor 4} with the type-(1,0) line of H^1(Cbar) in each of the four H_c^1 factors, and tensoring with Q(-2) produces a nonzero type-(10,6) class in Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(U;Q) and hence in Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q). Type (10,6) satisfies Deligne's Hodge-number bound (Theorie de Hodge III, Theorem 8.2.4(ii)) for dim U=10 and is not of type (8,8), so Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q) is not a finite direct sum of Q(-8) and T_16(Z) is not a finite direct sum of Q(8). The exact C66-TATE-SUPPORT theorem of campaign revision 4, universally quantified over every reduced locally Noetherian C-scheme carrying a (CE)+(N)+(BAL) family with no connected-component image contained in the type-(ii) locus, is therefore false. A repaired C66-TATE-SUPPORT must either name a specific base or atlas, or retain the FND-0167 hypotheses (H-S) including the j=6 corner Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S;Q). The exhibited class is the third FND-0167 summand Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S)(-2), realised as a Kunneth summand of H_c^{16}(U) itself on a product family, not a lift of Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(S); FND-0171, which blocks transport of the j=8 first summand through the corner injection on a pure-dimension-15 atlas, does not apply. Not asserted: any computation of the global kernel K, any conclusion about a fixed 15-dimensional atlas of Hbar^bal, or any statement about RED-0001.
contradiction_resolution: Mandatory first reads: ATT-0119 Sections 1-6 and claims CLM-0119-1 through CLM-0119-6 construct the constant simply-branched type-(i) family over S=C^8, identify U isomorphic to S times U_0 with H_c^4(U_0;Q)=Q(-2), and produce a Kunneth type-(10,6) class in Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(U;Q) that survives as an S_6-invariant in Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q). REV-0167 independently recomputes all six claims, records the present statement as FC-REV-0167-1, and in strongest_attack checks the dimension-8 versus dimension-15 attack: the exact theorem imposes no dominance, non-isotriviality, or dim-S=15 hypothesis, so the constant family over C^8 is in scope. Independent Hodge checks against Deligne, Theorie de Hodge III (Publ. Math. IHES 44 (1974), doi 10.1007/BF02685881): Proposition 8.2.10 realises ordinary Kunneth as an isomorphism of mixed Hodge structures, and the compact-support form for products of separated finite-type C-schemes is the corresponding statement for H_c (for the smooth factors C^8 and U_0 it is Poincare dual to 8.2.10); Theorem 8.2.4(ii) forces Hodge numbers of H^n(X) with dim X=N to vanish unless (p,q) lies in [n-N,N] x [n-N,N], so type (8,4) is permitted for H_c^{12} of the 8-fold C^8 and type (10,6) is permitted for H_c^{16} of the 10-fold U. Morphisms of mixed Hodge structures are strict for W (Theorie de Hodge II, Theoreme 2.3.5). Poincare duality on a smooth connected complex surface, equivalently compact-support localization of U_0 subset P^2 against a curve, gives H_c^4(U_0;Q)=Q(-2). The Kummer-curve input is the corroborated computation of FND-0170/CLM-0119-1: H_c^2(C)=Q(-1) and Gr^W_1 H_c^1(C) isomorphic to H^1(Cbar) of types (1,0) and (0,1); degree bookkeeping 2a+b=12 with a+b=8 forces a=b=4. Finite-etale transfer over Q injects H_c(U) as S_6-invariants into H_c(Z). No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty; CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, and RED-0001 concern Mbar_{g,n} or the open Borel-Moore corner of M_{g,n}, not T_16(Z) of an arbitrary-base Casnati-Ekedahl model. Compatible with corroborated FND-0167, which states (H-S) including j=6,7,8 only as hypotheses and does not assert them; with FND-0169, which refutes universal (H-S) at j=8 on atlas components without addressing Z; and with FND-0170, which explicitly withholds transport of non-Tateness to Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q). Distinct from FND-0171: that finding records that the FND-0167 corner injection cannot propagate non-Tateness of the j=8 first summand from a pure-dimension-15 atlas S to U, and that dim Delta=16 blocks the F^{15} lift; the present class is the third summand Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S)(-2), realised as an honest Kunneth summand of H_c^{16}(U) on a product family, so the FND-0171 block does not apply. Wording corrections relative to the candidate: (i) B is reduced as well as separated of finite type (clause (E) and the MHS formalism); (ii) the fibre is type (i), equivalently an allowed geometric fibre, not an arbitrary point of H^bal (a constant type-(ii) family is excluded by the type-(ii) image prohibition); (iii) U_0 is the reduced-support open of |L_0| isomorphic to P^2, not itself isomorphic to P^2 (REV-0167); (iv) survival in Z uses finite-etale S_6-invariants; (v) the forced base corner is specifically a finite direct sum of Q(-6); (vi) RED-0001 and the global kernel K are excluded; (vii) the j=6 instance of (H-S) is named as a necessary repair hypothesis, matching FND-0167 rather than inventing a new corner list. Promote the narrowed statement; do not merge.
